run: 2026-09-25, six fresh agents, prompt.md, checked by verify.sh and check.py against ground-truth.json (sealed first, commit 08ab94a). Every re-run reproduced the agent's own output byte for byte.
checker_fix: check.py first counted rio-1's stored-image record (640x400 px, no row) as a second placement and failed its picture check; fixed to require a row and column, after which rio-1 passes. The fix changed no other verdict.

ghostty-1.rows_held_note: 620 with max_scrollback 10,000 as documented; 10,295 after bisecting a byte budget of 10,838,016

rio-vt: the graphics feature is missing from the README; without it PNG pictures are dropped silently while the support query still answers OK
the README says the default feature set is empty; Cargo.toml defaults to pty
the README's EventListener snippet does not compile (it implements an event() method the trait does not have)
no documented way to read placements back: a public HashMap field whose rows are absolute and must be converted
the README quick-start's CrosswordsSize::new leaves the cell size at 0, which silently drops every picture (read in source; not hit)
no helper for the text of one visible row; combining marks need bounds_to_string
libghostty-vt: max_scrollback is documented as lines in the Rust docs and the C header but is a byte budget; 10,000 keeps 620 rows and no setting takes a line count (blocks step four)
the crate's own PNG decoder cannot be constructed, its doc example does not compile, and its decode path looks broken; each agent wrote its own (25 to 40 lines)
building needs Zig and a network git clone of Ghostty, which the main crate's docs do not say
Zig's cache escapes to ~/.cache/zig unless an undocumented variable is set
no cell pixel size at creation; it is set through resize(), whose doc calls unchanged dimensions a no-op
file-path pictures are off by default and undocumented in the Rust docs; with q=2 they drop silently
